_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::thermo#3 — MAT_Fourier.CAPA is volumetric heat capacity rho*c_p, and confusing it with the specific heat c_p is a silent factor-of-rho error in the thermal time constant. A 2x2 QUAD4 square with the whole boundary pinned leaves exactly one interior DOF, so the decay constant is strictly proportional to CAPA. With rho=7850, c_p=1: CAPA=7850 at t=392.5 s hits the asserted centre temperature ('is CORRECT', exit 0); CAPA=1 at the SAME physical time has already decayed to 4.16e-08 ('is WRONG --> actresult='); CAPA=1 at t=392.5/7850 hits the same value again ('is CORRECT') — the transient simply runs rho times too fast. UNITS_WARNINGS=0 records that 4C says nothing about it. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the second arm the volumetric CAPA too. It then matches the asserted temperature, 'is WRONG --> actresult=' disappears and EXIT_SPECIFIC_ONLY becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.

break the quantitative half: rescale the third arm's end time by something other than rho. The same centre temperature is then no longer reached, so TIME_CONSTANT_SCALES_WITH_CAPA flips to no and the fixture must go red.
